About This SUGRIV Demonstration

1. Simulated Operational Environment

All incident feeds, hazard coordinates, rover telemetry, and environmental readings in this prototype are entirely simulated in server memory. Zero external emergency APIs, databases, or cloud services are connected.

2. Intended Operational Hardware Role

In field deployment, the SUGRIV scout rover is a ruggedized unmanned ground vehicle equipped with Time-of-Flight LiDAR, narrow-FOV optical cameras, spot infrared radiometers, and 2.4GHz RF mesh relays for exploring confined structural voids prior to crew entry.

3. Mandatory Operator Verification

Autonomous sensor observations (e.g. cross-sectional corridor occlusions, thermal hotspots) are treated as preliminary alerts. They require explicit human operator confirmation before access routes are marked impassable or rescue teams are committed.

4. Simulated 3D Scene (Not Live Reconstruction)

The 3D site workspace is a tactical geometric simulation designed to demonstrate decision-making workflows. It is not a live photogrammetric or real-time point-cloud reconstruction.

5. Illustrative Recommendations (Not Guaranteed Safe)

Suggested approach routes and priority rankings are heuristic decision-support recommendations. No route is guaranteed structurally safe in dynamic collapse environments; final command authority resides with the Incident Commander.
